test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Select the option that arranges the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. with a supreme sense of rhythm and word appeal;

B. he was capable of writing angelic or weird poetry,

C. or the outlines of an unrelenting plot in a hard and dry style

D. yet he would write down a problem of morbid psychology
solution:
The correct answer is: **B, A, D, C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **B**: This part introduces the subject (he) and sets the tone for the sentence by describing the subject's capability in writing.</
